summary: Tested Wayly participant profile v2 schema (Tier 1/2/3), 4-step onboarding wizard, and ProfileCompletionBanner. Ran 10 existing pytest unit tests (all pass) + wrote 9 new API integration tests against the live preview backend (all pass). Drove the full Playwright flow as cathy@example.com through all 4 wizard steps; all data-testids resolved and the participant POST returned 201. Dashboard banner renders correctly at /app.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx is large (~800 lines including ProfileCompletionBanner) — consider splitting each step into its own component for maintainability.

create_participant always sets is_primary=true when there is no other ACTIVE primary, but Cathy already had legacy participants — new TEST participants are correctly created as non-primary. No bug, just noting the implicit branch.

POST /api/participants does not enforce idempotency. Calling it twice from the wizard (e.g. user double-clicks 'Save & continue') would create two participants. Recommend a client-side disable-on-submit or server-side dedupe.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_-prefixed participants on Cathy's account via the wizard + direct API (TESTDorothy TESTSmith, TESTAlice TESTJones, TESTPart TESTPension, plus PWCathy PWParent from the Playwright wizard run). They live alongside the legacy Dorothy participant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints under /api/participants/* are owned by participant_profile.py (registered before batch2/batch3 routers, so it wins). Dashboard route is /app, not /caregiver or /dashboard. Cathy's account already has a migrated legacy 'Dorothy' participant with requires_completion=true plus the TEST/PW participants from this run.
rca of the issue: No issues — all 13 review-request items pass.
